title: Filling: the acknowledgement marker, its control and what is recorded
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A filled inspection with a Monitor/Not OK response carrying a follow-up that requires acknowledgement.
custom_steps:
1. Before acknowledging, confirm the instruction header carries a Required marker in the colour of the response that triggered it, and the marker disappears once acknowledged.
2. Confirm the acknowledgement is a checkbox reading Acknowledge, becoming Acknowledged when set — not a button, not a toggle — and the technician cannot clear it.
3. Confirm the acknowledgement records who gave it and when, that this is not printed on the field card, and that it is surfaced in the inspection record's field detail.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Where the follow-up requires acknowledgement and none has been given, the instruction header carries a Required marker in the colour of the response that triggered it, and the marker disappears once acknowledged.
  • The acknowledgement is a checkbox reading Acknowledge, becoming Acknowledged when set; it is not a button or a toggle, and the technician cannot clear it.
  • The acknowledgement records who gave it and when; this is not printed on the field card but is surfaced in the inspection record's field detail.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R16: “Where the follow-up requires acknowledgement and none has been given, the instruction header will carry a Required marker in the colour of the response that triggered it. The marker disappears once acknowledged”
  • S19-R17: “The acknowledgement will be a checkbox reading Acknowledge, becoming Acknowledged when set. It is not a button, not a toggle, and the technician cannot clear it”
  • S19-R18: “The acknowledgement will record who gave it and when. That record will not be printed on the field card; it is surfaced in the inspection record's field detail”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
